Making a fork or modified version? See Crediting VineMix for required notices and our request for a short in-program acknowledgement.

Background

The opening adapts P Shader by Diego Biaggioni, an Orb effect generated with the 21st.dev Shader Builder. VineMix uses a muted mint palette. Attribution and MIT license.

The Downloads background is an original, silent canvas treatment inspired by the flowing waves and film grain in Music Reactive Hero Section by scott clayton (@lovesickfromthe6ix). No component code, audio or media from that preview is bundled.

Type, identity and icons

  • IBM Plex Sans by IBM. SIL Open Font License 1.1. The reader also uses the IBM Plex Sans Variable font under OFL 1.1.
  • VineMix mark, wordmark and native application artwork: project MIT license.
  • GitHub mark from Primer Octicons. Octicons MIT license.

Bundled icon assets include Lucide. Lucide ISC license and inherited MIT notices.

Product illustrations

The scrolling route uses detached renders of VineMix’s actual native controls, with example devices. The Low / Mid / High sequence blends nine native renders to illustrate changing settings. Animated meters use native artwork with simulated example levels. No audio is playing; these images do not show a live session or establish hardware compatibility. The route animation and its connections are original website code.

The seven-node audio pipeline also uses detached native controls and stereo meter artwork, with an illustrated speech EQ spectrum and signal handoff. Its timing demonstrates the route rather than measured processing latency. Pipeline artwork license.

Animation

The Download interaction recreates the visual treatment of Flow Hover Button by Vaibhav Kumar Singh (@vaib215) using original VineMix HTML and CSS.

The opening reuses the approved VineMix word-reader prototype. Its return-to-logo morph adapts Magic UI Morphing Text. Magic UI MIT license.

The reader's focus-letter selection and punctuation timing adapt RSVP Speed Reader by snowfluke. RSVP Speed Reader MIT license.

The application and optional drivers

Application component notices, Virtual Audio Cable terms, and VB-Audio terms apply separately. This website does not bundle driver installers.
